text:
Iris: Quick pulse on hydra-13b bring-up (longform advice + multi-doc summarization). Ran int6/int8 on a 1.1k token avg output cohort. Need routing guidance.

Tom K: Numbers? sample sizes?

Iris: 1,800 examples, human spot-check n=250. eval-bot below.

eval-bot: |metric|int6|int8|delta|
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|ROUGE-L|41.8|39.0|-2.8|
|QA F1|75.4|73.0|-2.4|
|Hallucination|5.1%|7.6%|+2.5pp|
|Cost/1k tokens|$0.118|$0.079|-33%|

Jules: Unit econ = ~33% cost save on int8. At 1.5M tokens/day that's ~ $49k/mo. But hallucination rise on long multi-doc outputs is concerning.

Tom K: Latency: int8 p50 ~12% faster; p95 unchanged. So cost is main reason to choose int8.

Iris: Proposal: default int8 for throughput-sensitive routes, but send predicted_complexity>0.45 to int6. Start with 10% GTN canary, expand to 25% holdback. Add fast fallback to int6 if hallucination > baseline +1pp over 3h window.

Jules: Also recommend shadowing a small floater group on fp16 for VIPs and saving counterexamples for product review.

ProductBot: Product note: run qualitative panel on 50 users for 48h at 25% holdback; report perceived completeness & factuality.

Iris: Routing JSON (planned): {"routes":[{"cond":"pred_complexity>0.45","model":"hydra-13b-int6"},{"cond":"default","model":"hydra-13b-int8"}],"initial_canary_pct":"10","holdback_pct":"25","fallback":"hydra-13b-int6"}

Tom K: Monitoring: ROUGE-L drift alert if delta >1.5 on canary slices, hallucination alert +1pp, ngram-repetition monitor for outputs>700 tokens.

Jules: +1. I'll prepare the scorecard slices: multi-doc, citation-heavy, instruction-rich. Will add example failure cases to the brief.

Iris: I'll create dashboards and roll the staging flag hydra-13b-routing-v1 tomorrow 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:
